subject.title: fix(claude-cli): preserve reused session on empty response

question: Should this PR land as a binding-only mitigation for all reused-session `empty_response` failures, or should it wait for a typed synthetic-placeholder lifecycle fix?
rationale: Source inspection cannot establish that every genuinely empty Claude CLI result is safely resumable, and the patch does not preserve the separately managed live process; maintainer intent is needed to choose the acceptable session-state boundary.

options.title: Require integrated lifecycle fix
options.body: Narrow preservation to a typed synthetic-placeholder outcome and prove persisted binding plus live-process behavior together before merge.

options.title: Land binding-only mitigation
options.body: Accept the broader empty-response exception as an interim mitigation after real runtime proof and explicitly keep process teardown as separate work.

options.title: Pause for overlapping PR
options.body: Wait for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90799 or a replacement classifier path to define the canonical terminal outcome first.

recommendation.title: Require integrated lifecycle fix
recommendation.body: Narrow preservation to a typed synthetic-placeholder outcome and prove persisted binding plus live-process behavior together before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Among the history candidates, this person is the strongest available owner for the maintainer-level choice between an interim mitigation and an integrated lifecycle boundary.
